name: data: a json body is parsed and its value projected (format defaults to json)
data: jsonl parses one value per non-blank line; blank lines are ignored
data: a reserved format with NO engine keeps the body raw and carries no value
data: an unknown format keeps the body raw and carries no value
data: a body the json engine rejects carries no value (the diagnostic is not projected; its absence is)
data: a nested json value round-trips through the projection intact, its map keys sorted
data: a member name that occurs twice in one object is outside the value domain, so the body carries no value
data: names are compared after their escapes are read, so "a" and "\u0061" are the same name
data: the same name in two different objects is no repetition
data: an escape that spells half a surrogate pair is outside the value domain
data: an escaped surrogate PAIR is one character
data: a number past the range of binary64 is outside the value domain
data: a number is its nearest binary64 value, so 1.0 is 1 and a long integer rounds
data: in jsonl the limits hold line by line
data: map keys print sorted by UTF-16 code unit, so "10" comes before "9" and both before "b"
